columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Delegated child agents must not expand parent authority
columns.title_zh: 子 Agent 委派不得扩大父级权限
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260819-004 with Skill 02 score 46/50. The change exposes a precise delegation invariant for digital employees: role customization may alter supported behavior or reduce capabilities, but parent-owned permissions, providers, endpoints, MCP servers and managed requirements remain authoritative across both spawn and resume paths. This is a bounded, testable authority-preservation mechanism and is less repetitive with the prior day's human-approval topic than today's other approval-oriented candidates.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260819-004，Skill 02 评分 46/50。该变更给出了一个清晰的数字员工委派不变量：角色自定义可以改变受支持的行为或收缩能力，但父级拥有的权限、Provider、Endpoint、MCP Server 与受管要求在新建和恢复路径中都保持权威。该机制边界明确、可测试，并且相较当天其他审批类候选，与前一日的人类审批主题重复更少。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify exactly which role fields are mutable, which authority-bearing fields are inherited unchanged, how capability reductions are enforced, whether resumed agents traverse the identical bounded-role path, how symlink rejection affects role-file trust, and which tests prove non-expansion. Do not generalize this mechanism into complete delegation security beyond the demonstrated configuration boundary.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查哪些 Role 字段可变、哪些承载权限的字段必须原样继承、能力收缩如何执行、恢复后的 Agent 是否经过同一受限 Role 路径、符号链接拒绝如何影响 Role 文件信任边界，以及哪些测试证明不会扩权；不得把该机制泛化为超出已证明配置边界的完整委派安全。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Asynchronous user messaging should be a delivery plane, not model context
columns.title_zh: 异步用户消息应属于交付平面，而非模型上下文
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260819-007 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It makes an architectural separation explicit: a root agent can emit user-visible asynchronous progress, receive immediate acceptance and continue the turn without feeding that message back into model input, while preserving delivery metadata through event conversion, history and replay. This creates a concrete separation among execution, user-delivery and model-context planes with direct implications for long-running agent runtimes and reconstructability.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260819-007，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它明确了一项架构分离：Root Agent 可以异步发送用户可见进度，立即获得 Accepted 并继续当前 Turn，同时不把该消息重新注入模型输入；Delivery Metadata 仍贯穿事件转换、历史与回放。这形成了执行平面、用户交付平面与模型上下文平面之间的具体分离，对长时运行 Agent Runtime 与可重建性具有直接价值。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact async message path, acceptance semantics, exclusion from model input, persistence and replay of delivery metadata, ordering relative to turn events, failure/cancellation behavior and regression tests. Keep the demonstrated delivery/context separation distinct from broader guarantees about end-to-end message delivery.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查异步消息的准确路径、Accepted 语义、如何排除于模型输入、Delivery Metadata 的持久化与回放、与 Turn 事件的顺序关系、失败/取消行为及回归测试；必须把已证明的交付/上下文分离与更广泛的端到端消息可靠性保证分开。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: OAuth refresh persistence failure must remain visible
columns.title_zh: OAuth 刷新后的凭据持久化失败必须显式暴露
columns.source_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260819-010 with Skill 02 score 43/50. It exposes a narrow but high-value reliability boundary in OAuth refresh handling: obtaining refreshed credentials and durably saving them are distinct failure domains, and a save failure must propagate instead of being misclassified as a refresh failure that starts a new authorization redirect. This is directly reproducible and prevents destructive state when refresh tokens rotate and the server has already invalidated the old credential.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260819-010，Skill 02 评分 43/50。它暴露了 OAuth 刷新处理中的一个窄而重要的可靠性边界：成功取得新凭据与将其持久保存属于不同失败域，保存失败必须向调用方暴露，不能被误分类为刷新失败并重新发起授权跳转。该机制可直接复现，并能避免 Refresh Token 轮换后服务器已使旧凭据失效、客户端却丢失新凭据的破坏性状态。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the refresh/save control flow before and after the change, exact exception propagation, rotating-refresh-token behavior, whether in-memory state is updated before persistence, retry expectations, compatibility impact and tests. Do not infer general OAuth transactionality beyond the demonstrated token-refresh persistence path.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查变更前后的 Refresh/Save 控制流、异常如何传播、旋转 Refresh Token 的行为、内存状态是否先于持久化更新、重试预期、兼容性影响及测试；不得从该 Token 刷新持久化路径推断一般化的 OAuth 事务性保证。
